overview.en: Macroglossum trochilus is a day-flying African hawkmoth.
overview.fr: Macroglossum trochilus est un sphinx africain diurne.

identification.en: Adults visit flowers in bright daylight.
identification.fr: Les adultes butinent en plein jour.

habitat.en: Records extend from southern to tropical Africa.
habitat.fr: Il est signalé d’Afrique australe à l’Afrique tropicale.

diet.en: Larvae feed on Galium and Rubia; adults sip nectar.
diet.fr: Les chenilles consomment Galium et Rubia ; les adultes boivent le nectar.

behavior.en: It is regularly active by day.
behavior.fr: Il est régulièrement actif de jour.

reproduction.en: Species-specific breeding details remain poorly documented.
reproduction.fr: La reproduction propre à l’espèce reste mal documentée.

ecology.en: Recorded larval hosts are both in Rubiaceae.
ecology.fr: Les hôtes larvaires recensés sont des Rubiacées.

conservation.en: No species-level conservation assessment was located.
conservation.fr: Aucune évaluation de conservation propre à l’espèce n’a été trouvée.

facts: The inventory's Hübner taxon is distinct from Cephonodes trochilus (Guérin-Méneville), whose former combination also used the name Macroglossum trochilus.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The old combination Macroglossum trochilus has also been used for the separate Cephonodes trochilus (Guérin-Méneville, 1843); this record refers to the African species Macroglossum trochilus (Hübner, 1823). The available host-plant and natural-history records are incomplete.
review_note: Cross-checked an African species account and a peer-reviewed Mozambique faunal paper; kept the Hübner taxon distinct from the similarly named Cephonodes species.
